long_biography.plain_text:
Pixmania grew from an attempt to bring the Rosenblum family's photo-processing operation online. Steve Rosenblum and his younger brother, Jean-Emile, redirected the idea toward selling cameras and other electronics, then used an investment-backed buyout to take control of the wider family group. Steve led Pixmania as it developed into a large European e-commerce business before the brothers sold their remaining stake.

After that exit, Rosenblum moved between investing and new ventures. He and Jean-Emile backed technology companies through Dotcorp, while Steve separately developed the customisable fashion concept BAIA BAIA. He later founded Libertify, an artificial-intelligence company that turns static business documents into guided interactive experiences. The sequence distinguishes the inherited family platform from his own operating role: family access created an advantage, but the wealth-producing e-commerce expansion and later ventures required active entrepreneurship.
